$comment: Structure-only config for the svg-banner skill. Watermark whitelist, mark image, and label text. Color values come from .github/config/brand-palette.json (background = brand.primaryDark, gradient = gradient[], title text = typography.textOnDark, subtitle text = brand.muted, accent = brand.primary, brand sub-label = brand.muted, watermark = typography.textOnDark). Font stack comes from brand-palette typography.fontStack. Heirs edit brand-palette.json to rebrand colors project-wide; edit this file to change watermark vocabulary, brand label text, or mark image.
